documents.title: Service policy
documents.text: Prep and local delivery are for Las Vegas residents only. We ship dry lyophilized vials only — not reconstituted product. Educational information only. The team calls to confirm, consult, and complete required documentation before payment.

documents.title: Locked information sheets
documents.text: Each live SKU has a locked information sheet as a Telegram file. Tap Sheet. Mix, starting amounts, and syringe marks live on that PDF — not in chat. Shop pages in Links are not the sheets.

documents.title: Payment
documents.text: Local Las Vegas: Zelle is best. The team shares Zelle details on the confirmation call. Prefer debit card? Tap Team, then Debit. Telegram interest orders are for Las Vegas residents only.

documents.title: Sales and discounts
documents.text: The floor team never invents a sale. A promotion appears only after TrueHold staff approve it case by case. If no approved promo is on file, there is no sale.

documents.title: No dosing in chat
documents.text: This host does not provide dosing, reconstitution, injection, or medical advice in chat. Tap Sheet for the locked PDF, or Team to talk with a person. Respect the tools.

documents.title: Why we are here
documents.text: We care that people get healthy, and we walk with them. Use the tools nature and God already gave us. High-quality food and rest make a high-quality human. Peptides can help you aim at your best health. Educational only. If this house helped, you're welcome to tell others.

documents.title: Nature, science, and memory
documents.text: These signals showed up in bone broths, herbs, and fermentation long before lab glass. A lot of that kitchen knowledge was lost. Science opened the door again — like seeing it for the first time. Most peptides already exist in the human body. They are naturally occurring. You're welcome to know. Mix math stays on the locked sheet, not in chat.

documents.title: Respect, with care
documents.text: Too much of anything — even oxygen — can seriously hurt you. TrueHold Wellness agrees: these are tools to respect, not toys. We will not dose in chat. We'll keep the facts open and kind. Learn with us — the door stays open.

documents.title: Vitamin C and oranges
documents.text: Vitamin C in oranges was never meant to feel like someone else's permission slip. We learn how to use naturally occurring tools with care, and we keep the kitchen door open. Honest information belongs with the people who need it. If this house helped, you're welcome to tell someone else.

documents.title: What you put in
documents.text: Empowerment can mean feeling at home in your own body. What you put in produces the human you are. High-quality food and rest equal a high-quality human. We have a right to pursue our best health. Peptides are one of the tools that can help. Educational information. Las Vegas, dry vials, team consult for orders.
